purpose: Make a shared workshop welcoming without losing useful quiet time.
context: An invented small workshop has mixed arrival times.

alternatives.action: Offer a short opening, then quiet work.
exceptions: Skip when everyone already has shared context.

alternatives.action: Offer individual orientation at the door.

voices.author: synthetic-participant
voices.contribution: I need a visible welcome before starting.

disposition.reason: Hear from late arrivals before choosing.

questions: What would be fitting for a newcomer?

cultivation.exercise: Compare a familiar group with first-time visitors.
cultivation.contrast: A routine can help one group and confuse another.
